subdivision_of_building: Ground and Basement Floors, please see attached proposed floor plans reference: JS/SP/1460/3/08
decision_conditions: <p>The proposal would result in the loss of an existing ground floor commercial unit whereby the applicant has failed to demonstrate through robust marketing evidence undertaken in accordance with Appendix 1 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033, that there is no realistic prospect of the unit continuing in commercial use contrary to policy LP36 and Appendix 1 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), which seek to safeguard retail uses outside designated centres that contribute to local shopping provision and neighbourhood vitality.</p><div><br></div>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of the provision of substandard accommodation for future occupiers. The proposed front basement bedroom would rely on a sun pipe and internal lightwell as its primary source of sunlight and daylight,&nbsp; would lack meaningful outlook, and would not benefit from an openable window to provide adequate ventilation. This would result in poor levels of daylight, outlook, and ventilation, to the detriment of the long-term health and well-being of future occupiers of the development, contrary to policy D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021) and policy LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and the&nbsp;<span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;">Technical housing standards – nationally described space standard (2015). </span></p><div><span style="background-color: transparent; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; white-space-collapse: preserve; text-align: justify;"><br></span></div>

<p><span data-sheets-root="1" style="">The proposed development, by reason of a lack of provision of affordable housing, would fail to adequately contribute towards the provision of mixed and balanced communities and housing needs in the local area. As such, the development would not be consistent with policy H4 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-2bdd3438-7fff-ba05-18f6-21fdff457283"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Delivering affordable housing)</span></span>&nbsp;of the London Plan (2021), and policies LP12 (</span>Meeting Housing Needs and Locations for New Homes), and&nbsp;LP13 (Affordable Housing) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), and NPPF (2024) paragraph 64, and the Hackney S106 Planning Contributions Supplementary Planning Document (2020).</p>

<p>In the absence of a suitable undertaking to secure that the occupiers of the new residential units would not be able to apply for on street parking permits, the proposals would have an adverse impact on street parking conditions, highway safety and sustainable modes of transport, contrary to policies T1 (<span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Strategic approach to transport</span><span style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;), T2 (Healthy streets), T4 (</span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and T5 (Car parking) of</span><span style="text-align: justify;">&nbsp;the London Plan (2021) and policies LP41 (Liveable neighbourhoods), LP42 (Walking and cycling), LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car-Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020).</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-18b27278-7fff-26ca-b126-055d95242b1a"></span><span style="text-align: justify;"><br></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-ba34ce7b-7fff-8ac8-e6f6-5d079d72e38a"></span><br></p>

<p>The proposed development, by reason of a lack of sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, would fail to achieve the maximum feasible reductions in carbon dioxide emissions, contrary to policies LP54 (<span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Overheating and Adapting to Climate Change) and </span><span style="text-align: justify;">LP55 (</span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Mitigating Climate Change</span><span style="text-align: justify;">)&nbsp; of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020) and policies SI 2 (</span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Minimising greenhouse gas emissions</span><span style="text-align: justify;">) and SI 4 (</span><span style="text-align: justify; font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Managing heat risk</span><span style="text-align: justify;">) of the London Plan (2021).</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-cf193a37-7fff-5a65-13a6-49138a6e2f71"></span><span style="text-align: justify;"><br></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-e9164725-7fff-144e-ac48-dcc0388c5bee"></span><span style="text-align: justify;"><br></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-886517a1-7fff-bacf-597c-c61d7e1a8be8"></span><span style="text-align: justify;"><br></span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b2c80fa1-7fff-e2e4-09d3-5185fe3e71de"></span><br></p>
description: Change of use of the existing ground and basement floor commercial unit from Class E (commercial) to Class C3 (residential), a self-contained 2-bed 4-person flat.
